mandate: C339 — test the cross-sectional intraday ORDER-FLOW / RETURN DIRECTION ALIGNMENT SEASONAL DISLOCATION statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1944 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: sign_imb=sign(signed_volume/total_volume) (total_volume<=0 -> NaN); sign_r=sign(log_return) (always finite); align=sign_imb*sign_r (+1 aligned, -1 misaligned). Metrics over trailing lookback L bars ending at bar t-1: align_mean=mean(align); align_abs=|align_mean|; align_z=(align_mean-seasonal_mean)/seasonal_std. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), min_periods=3, NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 3 real *_dev/_z + 3 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: total_volume<=0 -> sign_imb/align NaN; metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0; raw flow fields carry zero NaN except zero-activity denominators.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements plus rare zero-activity bars.

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; signed_volume/total_volume real from C312.
methodology.primitives: sign_imb=sign(signed_volume/total_volume) (tv<=0 -> NaN); sign_r=sign(log_return) (always finite); align=sign_imb*sign_r (+1/-1 aligned/misaligned).
methodology.signals: align_mean/align_abs/align_z over trailing L bars ending at t-1; score=sign*(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1944 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 6 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
